title: Selection and reselection of synchronisation reference

entities.name: Synchronization Reference Selection Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to select and reselect synchronization reference for NR sidelink communication based on configured priorities, measurements, and conditions.

entities.name: Cell as Synchronization Reference
entities.description: Synchronization reference source from a cell when sl-SyncPriority is set to gnbEnb and frequency is configured in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR or SIB12.

entities.name: GNSS as Synchronization Reference
entities.description: Synchronization reference source from GNSS when sl-SyncPriority is set to gnss and GNSS is reliable according to TS 38.101-1 and TS 38.133.

entities.name: SyncRef UE as Synchronization Reference
entities.description: Synchronization reference source from another UE detected via SLSS with sufficient PSBCH-RSRP measurement.

entities.name: GNSS is reliable
entities.description: Condition where GNSS meets reliability requirements as defined in TS 38.101-1 and TS 38.133.

entities.name: PSBCH-RSRP exceeds minimum requirement
entities.description: Condition where PSBCH-RSRP measurement exceeds the minimum requirement defined in TS 38.133 by sl-SyncRefMinHyst.

entities.name: Higher priority group
entities.description: Condition where candidate synchronization reference belongs to a higher priority group than current reference.

entities.name: sl-SyncPriority
entities.description: Information element that configures synchronization priority (gnbEnb or gnss) for NR sidelink communication frequency.

entities.name: sl-SyncRefMinHyst
entities.description: Information element that defines hysteresis value for PSBCH-RSRP minimum requirement comparison.

entities.name: Priority group order
entities.description: Property defining the order of priority groups for synchronization reference selection based on sl-SyncPriority configuration.

relations.description: Procedure includes step to select cell as synchronization reference when conditions are met.
Procedure includes step to select GNSS as synchronization reference when conditions are met.
Procedure includes step to select SyncRef UE as synchronization reference when conditions are met.
Selection of GNSS as synchronization reference requires GNSS to be reliable.
Selection of SyncRef UE requires PSBCH-RSRP to exceed minimum requirement with hysteresis.
Procedure reselection is guarded by higher priority group condition.
Procedure behavior is guarded by sl-SyncPriority configuration.
PSBCH-RSRP condition is defined using sl-SyncRefMinHyst parameter.
Procedure establishes priority group order for synchronization reference selection.
